methods.steps: ffmpeg -i reaction.gif -c:v libvpx -pix_fmt yuv420p -an reaction.webm
methods.limits: Requires libvpx. Writes opaque VP8 video.

methods.steps: gst-launch-1.0 filesrc location=reaction.gif ! gifdec loop=force-no ! videoconvert ! vp8enc ! webmmux ! filesink location=reaction.webm
methods.limits: Requires the gif, vpx and Matroska plug-ins. Writes a silent video.

methods.steps: File > Open the JPEG; File > Export As; enter a file name with the .ico ending and click Export.
methods.limits: Export type is listed as Microsoft Windows icon.

methods.steps: magick portrait.jpeg -alpha off -define icon:auto-resize="16,32,48,64,96,128,256" favicon.ico
methods.limits: Writes seven sizes into one ICO; input should be square.

methods.steps: File > Open the JPEG; File > Save as; choose ICO as output format, set the file name and save.
methods.limits: Lists ICO as a format it can read and save.

methods.steps: magick texture.tga texture.png
methods.limits: Format list shows TGA and PNG as RW.

methods.steps: File > Open the TGA; File > Export As; name it texture.png; confirm the options in the PNG export dialog.
methods.limits: PNG dialog lists pixel format and metadata options.

methods.steps: File > Open the Targa; File > Save as; choose PNG as output format and save.
methods.limits: Format list marks TGA and PNG as readable and savable.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i phone.3gp -c:v libx264 -c:a aac phone.mp4
methods.limits: Re-encodes video and audio. Requires libx264 and an AAC encoder.

methods.steps: Media > Convert/Save; Add the file; type the Destination file; choose a conversion profile from the Profile drop-down; Start.
methods.limits: Lists 3GP among its input formats.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i recording.mts -c:v libx264 -c:a aac recording.mp4
methods.limits: Re-encodes video and audio. Requires libx264 and an AAC encoder.

methods.steps: Open Source; select the Fast 1080p30 preset; type a name in Save As; click Start.
methods.limits: A full encode. AVCHD playlists are not fully supported.

methods.steps: gst-launch-1.0 -e mp4mux name=container ! filesink location=recording.mp4 filesrc location=recording.mts ! decodebin ! queue ! videoconvert ! x264enc ! h264parse ! container.video_0
methods.limits: Writes video only, with no sound. Needs decoders for the input plus x264enc, h264parse and mp4mux.

methods.steps: File > Open the BMP; File > Save as; choose JPG as output format and set the new file name.
methods.limits: Format list marks BMP and JPG as readable and savable.

methods.steps: File > Open the BMP; File > Export As; name the file capture.jpg and press Export; set Quality in the JPEG export dialog.
methods.limits: JPEG has no layers or transparency.

methods.steps: magick capture.bmp -quality 85 capture.jpg
methods.limits: -quality sets the compression level for JPEG encoders.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i archive.flv -vn -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k archive.mp3
methods.limits: Requires an audio stream. Re-encodes it rather than copying MP3 packets.

methods.steps: gst-launch-1.0 filesrc location=archive.flv ! decodebin ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! lamemp3enc ! filesink location=archive.mp3
methods.limits: Audio only. Needs an FLV demuxer, an audio decoder and the LAME encoder.

methods.steps: gif2webp animation.gif -o animation.webp
methods.limits: Offers -lossy and -mixed options.

methods.steps: magick animation.gif -coalesce animation.webp
methods.limits: Needs WebP support in your ImageMagick; check its format list.

methods.steps: Music > Settings > Files > Import Settings; choose MP3 Encoder in the Import Using menu and click OK; select the song; File > Convert > Create MP3 Version.
methods.limits: Does not convert older purchases that remain Protected AAC.

methods.steps: heif-dec photo.heif photo.png
methods.limits: A file with several images is written as numbered files.

methods.steps: File > Open the HEIF; File > Export As; type photo.png as the name and click Export.
methods.limits: HEIF import needs GIMP 2.10.2 or later.

methods.steps: magick photo.heic photo.png
methods.limits: Reads HEIC only when the libheif delegate library is present.
